body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 31b7f0236c37961a3504705664639bec17d5da67 -->

This is a read-only review. The reviewer did not build the change. The author's zola run is noted (zola 0.23.6, build clean; 16 site tests pass on head c87fba57d).

## Checks

1. Diff: three files, as the body says. No process file changed, so no `Process change: yes` line is needed. No UI snapshot PNG changed.
2. `site/templates/index.html`: the new img sits above the h1 inside `section.hero`. It uses `get_url`, like the other static files. It has alt text and a fixed size of 128 by 128 px.
3. `site/static/style.css`: one new rule, one added property. The style matches the rules beside it. No other rule uses the class `logo`. The image file is not edited for the round corners; the CSS does it.
4. `site/static/camcraft-logo.png`: the bytes equal `assets/logo/icons/camcraft-256.png` of this repository. That file comes from `cargo xtask logo`. The mark is our own original isometric glyph. It is not stock art, and it is not another company's mark. No new license notice is needed.
5. PR body: complete. It has the description, the screenshot, the test result, the line `Changelog: none`, and the closing line for issue 2045. The push at 22:34 UTC was before the ready flag at 22:35 UTC, so the no-push-while-ready rule holds.

## Findings (no blockers)

- The test note names head `c87fba57d`. The final head has one more commit. It changes only the logo margin in `style.css`. The site tests do not read that file, and zola copies it as is. The risk is low. Run the check again on the final head next time.
- The copy in `site/static/` needs a manual refresh when the logo changes. The body says this. It matches the accepted option in the issue.
- The centering of the h1 is a layout choice. It keeps the page coherent with the centered logo. It is within the maintainer's request.

Verdict: clean. The PR merges when reviewed per its class.
